activities.name: My personal essay reflects on how experiencing loss, including suicide, changed
activities.description: My personal essay reflects on how experiencing loss, including suicide, changed how I think about certainty, assumptions, and arguments. Rather than focusing on events themselves, the essay explores learning to pause before drawing conclusions, to listen for what is missing, and to approach people’s stories with more empathy.
